headline: 983 children dead as measles outbreak kills 4 more in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in measles-related deaths and hospitalizations across Bangladesh.
details: Four more children died within 24 hours showing symptoms of measles, according to a DGHS update on Wednesday.
A total of 1,009 children were admitted to hospitals with measles or measles-like symptoms during the same period.
Since March 15, 884 children have died with measles symptoms and another 99 have died from confirmed measles cases, bringing the total death toll to 983.
The situation remains critical, with 1,231 children hospitalized on Tuesday alone, just a day prior to the latest report.

headline: ACC investigates corruption allegations against Asif Mahmud
summary: The interim government adviser is the first from his administration to face an ACC probe into recruitment and promotion irregularities at the Ministry of Youth and Sports.
details: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has launched an investigation into allegations of corruption and irregularities in recruitment, transfers, and promotions at the Ministry of Youth and Sports.
The probe targets Asif Mahmud Shojib Bhuyain, who served as an adviser to the ministry during the interim government, along with three other officials.
Allegations include the collection of Tk 76 lakh for cancelling existing responsibilities of 38 upazila youth development officers and issuing new posting orders.
The complaint further alleges that Tk 1.5 crore was taken for the promotion of 150 assistant upazila youth development officers.
Additionally, another Tk 2 crore was allegedly collected to secure postings at preferred locations following those promotions.
The investigation also involves former Youth and Sports Ministry Secretary Md Mahbub-ul-Alam, former Joint Secretary Sheikh Mohammad Zobayer Hossain, and Deputy Secretary Md Masum Ahmed.
A four-member inquiry team led by ACC Deputy Director Md Zahid Kalam has been formed to look into the matter.
Asif Mahmud is the first adviser from the interim government to face an ACC investigation over corruption allegations.
caption:
Tk 4.26 crore in alleged bribes for postings and promotions. Asif Mahmud becomes the first interim government adviser to face an ACC probe.

The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has launched an investigation into allegations of corruption and irregularities in recruitment, transfers, and promotions at the Ministry of Youth and Sports.

The probe targets Asif Mahmud Shojib Bhuyain, who served as an adviser to the ministry during the interim government, along with three other officials.

Allegations include the collection of Tk 76 lakh for cancelling existing responsibilities of 38 upazila youth development officers and issuing new posting orders.

The complaint further alleges that Tk 1.5 crore was taken for the promotion of 150 assistant upazila youth development officers.

Additionally, another Tk 2 crore was allegedly collected to secure postings at preferred locations following those promotions.

The investigation also involves former Youth and Sports Ministry Secretary Md Mahbub-ul-Alam, former Joint Secretary Sheikh Mohammad Zobayer Hossain, and Deputy Secretary Md Masum Ahmed.

A four-member inquiry team led by ACC Deputy Director Md Zahid Kalam has been formed to look into the matter.

Asif Mahmud is the first adviser from the interim government to face an ACC investigation over corruption allegations.
